result.instructions: Tools for MagicBell, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes MagicBell data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run magicbell_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run magicbell_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run magicbell_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. magicbell_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: magicbell_list_broadcasts
tools.title: List broadcasts
tools.description: List broadcasts (notification-send batches) with cursor pagination. Read-only observability. Project API: GET /broadcasts.

starting_after.description: Cursor: return items after this id (next page).

ending_before.description: Cursor: return items before this id (previous page).

tools.name: magicbell_create_user
tools.title: Create a user
tools.description: Creates a user (notification recipient) record in MagicBell. Additive — sends no notification. Provide at least one identifier (external_id or email). Project API: POST /users.

external_id.description: Your own stable id for this user (recommended identifier).

custom_attributes.description: Arbitrary key/value metadata for the user.
